sentences.text:
Pratima Sadhukhan & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal on 4
December, 2025

Author: Rajasekhar Mantha
Bench: Rajasekhar Mantha
04.12.2025
Court No.13
Item No.3
Ap
 Cra 344 of 2016
 With
 Cran 2 of 2025

Pratima Sadhukhan & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal
 Mr. Avishek Sinha
 Ms. S. Naaz
 ... For the Appellants.

Mr. Saibal Bapuli, A.P.P.
 Mr. B. Bhattacharya
 ...

1. 
A report dated 24th November, 2025 of the Superintendent, Alipore Women's Correctional Home has been placed before this Court by the counsel for the State in respect of Pratima Sadhukhan and the same is taken on record.

2. Another report dated 22nd November, 2025 of the Superintendent, Midnapore Central Correction Home in respect of Madhai Sadhukhan and Debasish Sadhukhan has also been placed before this Court by the learned counsel for the State and the same is taken on record.

3. On merit it is argued that there is a good chance of success in the appeal because the allegation under Section 498A or 302 of the IPC was not made by the prosecution witnesses in course of inquest.
The acquittal under Section 498A negates the motive of the appellants to commit the crime.
It is further argued that there is evidence on record to indicate that the applicants Madhai Sadhukhan and Debasish Sadhukhan do not reside in the premises.
Hence, the requirement of explaining the death of the victim on Madhai Sadhukhan and Debasish Sadhukhan was totally misplaced by the Trial Court.
